description: Port of typescript-eslint's `consistent-type-assertions` rule (https://typescript-eslint.io/rules/consistent-type-assertions) at its default options (assertion style `as`, object and array literal assertions allowed). Flags every angle-bracket type assertion `<T>value`, which should be written `value as T`.

violation.message: Use `value as T` instead of the angle-bracket assertion `<T>value`.
